title: Open cohomology map of a fixed resolution lift
statement: For scheme morphisms f:X to S and g:S′ to S, a module sheaf F, injective resolutions I of F and J of g′^*F, any complex map t:I to g′_*J, an integer p at least zero, an open V of S and D:FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices(f,g,F,I,J,V), define flatBaseChangeResolutionOpenMap by rS.hom followed by H^p of the section-complex map of flatBaseChangeResolutionQ, followed by rT.inv. Here rS and rT are the isomorphisms from cohomology of the restricted modules to homology of sections of the original resolutions, obtained by composing the canonical isoRightDerivedObj, the inverse forgetful homology comparison, and H^p of D.source.sections or D.target.sections (the latter transported through flatBaseChangeOpenEquality). These are actual specified isomorphisms; no arbitrary existence witness is chosen. The constructions are [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-construction] and [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices].

def flatBaseChangeResolutionOpenMap {X S S' : Scheme.{uBC}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    {F : X.Modules}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (t : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (p : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V) :
    (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).obj
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
        ((restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F)) ⟶
    (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).obj
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
        ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
          ((restrictFunctor ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).obj
            ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F)))
